meta.name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
meta.description: Elite mobile app image-generation skill for creating premium, app-native screen concepts and flows. Designed for iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products. Prioritizes clean hierarchy, comfortably readable text, strong multi-screen consistency, controlled color palettes, non-generic creative direction, textured surfaces, image-led composition, tasteful custom iconography, and clean phone mockup framing. By default, screens should be shown inside a subtle premium iPhone or similar phone mockup with a visible frame, while the main focus stays on the app content itself. This skill generates images only. It does not write code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Generate premium mobile app screen concepts and flows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce visual drafts or demo screenshots for mobile apps.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会直接产出手机 App 的界面图和整套流程图的图像,例如引导页、首页、个人页等,默认把界面放进干净的手机外框里展示。它只出图,不写代码。
howto.when: 当你要求做移动端 App 界面或界面流程(如引导、首页等),或指明是 iOS、Android、跨平台概念时触发。网站、落地页、桌面端和代码实现不在范围内。

say.text: 做一组引导页,每一屏构图都要有区别

say.text: 安卓端理财 App 的首页,换套配色再来一版

howto.what_en: Claude generates mobile app screen images and screen flows (onboarding, home, profile, etc.) for iOS, Android or cross-platform. Screens sit inside a clean phone mockup by default. Images only — no code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mobile app screens or screen flows (onboarding, home, profile) or name iOS, Android or cross-platform. Websites, landing pages, desktop dashboards and code are out of scope.

say_en.text: Make a 5-screen iOS ecommerce app flow concept
Design an onboarding set where each screen differs
Redo the Android finance app home screen in a new palette
say_en.note: Regenerates that home screen in Android style
